GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG311.7 (23 Feb 46) CCS
(SCAPIN-766)
APO 500
23 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Transportation and Handling of Repatriation Mail
1. Reference is made to memorandum this Headquarters to the Imperial Japanese Government, File AG 311.7(28 Oct 45)CIS dated 28 October 1945, Subject, “Establishment of Limited Mail System for Japanese Awaiting Repatriation” and file AG 311.7 (1 Oct 45) CIS dated 1 October 1945, Subject “Censorship of the Mail.”
2. Transportation of repatriation mail on repatriation surface shipping is authorized. The Appropriate Japanese will receive notification as to the availability of these facilities form one Shipping Control Administration for Japanese Merchant Shipping.
3. All income and outgoing mail will be submitted to the appropriate censorship stations, assigned by the Civil Censorship Detachment, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M FITCH
Brigadier General, A. G. D.
Adjutant General.
